title.narrative: Programme Support to Office of the Auditor General in Zambia (2022-2025)

description.narrative:
The functions of the Auditor General are to audit the accounts of State Organs, State institutions, Provincial Administration, Local Authorities and other institutions financed from public funds. The mission of OAG is to provide timely quality audit services to promote transparency and accountability in the management of public resources for the well-being of the citizenry.
The 2022 2026 Strategic Plan provides for six (6) objectives:
1. Improve audit services
2. Improve stakeholder engagement
3. Enhance resource mobilization and management
4. Improve operational systems and procedures
5. Enhance human capital
6. Improve infrastructure, tools and equipment

Riksrevisorns uppgifter är att granska räkenskaperna för statliga organ, statliga institutioner, landskapsförvaltningen, lokala myndigheter och andra institutioner som finansieras med offentliga medel. OAG:s uppdrag är att tillhandahålla revisionstjänster av hög kvalitet i rätt tid för att främja transparens och ansvarighet i förvaltningen av offentliga resurser för medborgarnas välbefinnande”. Detta bidrag är tänkt att stödja ansvarsskyldighet och minska korruptionen i Zambia genom OAG.

title.narrative: Decision Real Team Audit Disatser Drought National Plan

description.narrative:
1) Improve audit services: Tragets were met and audits were carried out on key government ministries and agencies. There was a 100 percent coverage of audit of the local authorities for the first time. Lessons learned: There is a need for improved resource mobilisation to address persistent logistical and staffing constraints continuous capacity building and equitable workload distribution in enhancing audit quality and timeliness.
2) Improve stakeholder engagement: The stakeholder engagement strategy was implemented with various engagement activities such as research activities and televisions and radio sensitization programs. Enhanced visibility and accessibility of Office OAG mandate and audit processes. OAG strengthened the digital presence via social media platforms, including 13 television and radio programs conducted with local media, fostering twoway communication with citizens and developed simplified audit reports to improve stakeholder comprehension to promote greater public interest in public financial management.
3) Enhanced resource mobilisation: The audit of the RIPD 2023 account has been conducted as well as a resource mobilisation strategy.
4) Improve operational systems and procedures: The ZEDSEAT system has replaced he AMS system. Being an AFROSAIE supported platform (ASEAT), ZEDSEAT offers a standardized, regionally aligned solution that will minimize the need for external consultations and system maintenance. Its integration has streamlined audit workflows, improved compliance with international standards, and strengthened the Offices capacity to deliver timely and high quality audits.
A monitoring and evaluation of the ICT equipment across all provincial offices have taken place, including maintenance of network deployment of SAP Software configuring mail to employee Phones and installation of Microsoft 2016, 2019 and 365.
5) Enhanced human capital: Capacity training has been conducted according to plan. The work culture satisfaction is well below target and needs much more attention. Lessons learned are that the work culture need restructuring, better leadership skills and communication.
6) Improve infrastructure, tools and equipment. The activities contributed to improved mobility for audit teams reduced vehicle downtime and timely execution of field audit assignments.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
